title: Talent Intelligence Report
description: The structured shape the ENRICH stage produces when running the analyst profile (as opposed to the lighter screen-writeup profile in output-schema.json). The FORMAT stage renders this into a professionally templated .docx via tools/render_docx.js. Section numbering matches config/analyst-prompt.md.

sourced_field.description: A candidate-information field plus where it came from. Provenance is required so the renderer can show what was confirmed on the call versus carried in from the ATS.

value.description: The extracted value, or the literal string UNKNOWN / INSUFFICIENT DATA. Never guess.

source.description: transcript = stated on the call; ats = carried in from the candidate record; config = supplied by the operator; not_found = neither the transcript nor the record covered it.

quote.description: Verbatim supporting quote from the transcript when source is transcript.

candidate_info.description: Section 1. Every field is provenance-tracked; the renderer prints UNKNOWN rather than an empty cell so a reader can never mistake a gap for a negative.

work_policy_confirmation.description: The candidate's response to the work policy defined in config/company-profile.json, including any conditions or concerns they raised. Never summarize a hedge into a yes.

salary_expectations.description: Forward-looking expectations only. Salary HISTORY must never be recorded here even if the candidate volunteered it — route it to compliance.violations instead.

recruiter_recommendation.description: ALWAYS null on generation. The renderer prints the placeholder from company-profile.report.recommendation_placeholder so a human fills it in. The model must never populate this.

topics.description: 3-5 major topic areas, each a bold heading plus a prose paragraph.

body.description: Prose, not bullets. Include metrics wherever the transcript supplies them.

strategic_insights.description: Step 3 external research. Rendered under an [AI INSIGHT] tag. Null when no credible sources were found — never fabricate.

summary.description: Three sentences on employer trajectory overlapping the candidate's tenure: funding, M&A, launches, headcount changes.

sources.description: 1-2 verifiable sources per employer researched. An empty array forces the renderer to print the no-credible-sources notice.

interview_highlights.description: Key takeaways on technical aptitude, motivation, and cultural alignment.

risks.description: Explicit risks only. Empty array means the renderer omits the subsection entirely rather than printing 'none'.

compliance.description: Section 3. Populated by the Step 1 scrub, which runs BEFORE extraction so protected-characteristic content never reaches Sections 1 or 2.

violations.description: Every problematic question, logged regardless of intent. Empty array renders the explicit no-violations statement.

category.description: Protected characteristic or prohibited topic. Must match a category *label* in config/legal-reference.json exactly — e.g. 'National Origin / Citizenship', 'Salary History', 'Disability / Medical'. The label is what the renderer prints as the heading; the machine-readable id sits alongside it in the legal reference.

analysis.description: Why this is problematic and what the exposure is.

framework.description: Which frameworks the item implicates, e.g. ['Title VII', 'FEHA'].

scrubbed_from_analysis.description: True once the flagged content has been withheld from Sections 1 and 2. The renderer refuses to produce a document when violations exist and this is false.
